title: Composite construction and relaxation
action: Build a 3×3 h-BN supercell with at least 15 Å vacuum, substitute one B N pair with two C atoms, perform a full geometry relaxation using DFT (PBE functional with Grimme D3 dispersion) until forces are below standard convergence criteria, and save the relaxed structure.
description: Process step: relaxed CBN-composite geometry needed for all downstream calculations.

title: Composite band gap computation
action: Using the relaxed composite structure, compute the electronic band structure and extract the band gap. Write the result to cbn_band_gap.json.
description: Band gap of the CBN-composite; consistency check.

title: Single gas adsorption calculations
action: For each gas (SO2, N2, O2, CO2, H2O, NO, NO2, CO): create multiple initial adsorption configurations, perform DFT relaxation, identify the most stable configuration, compute E_ads and charge transfer, and write the results.
description: Adsorption energies and charge transfers for the eight gases; the main selectivity and sensitivity result.
output_schema: Columns: gas (str), E_ads (float, eV), charge_transfer (float, e).

title: Co-adsorption of SO2 and H2O
action: Build a co-adsorption configuration with SO2 and H2O on the relaxed composite, perform DFT relaxation, compute adsorption energies and charge transfers, and write the results.
description: Co-adsorption energies to assess humidity resistance.
output_schema: Columns: gas (str), E_ads (float, eV), charge_transfer (float, e).
